entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `conversationId` TEXT NOT NULL, `messageId` TEXT NOT NULL, `senderId` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `expiresAt` INTEGER, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `flags` INTEGER NOT NULL, `body` TEXT NOT NULL, `normBody` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`normBody` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`search_messages`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_messages_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `search_messages` BEGIN DELETE FROM `search_messages_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_messages_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `search_messages` BEGIN DELETE FROM `search_messages_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_messages_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `search_messages` BEGIN INSERT INTO `search_messages_fts`(`docid`, `normBody`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`normBody`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_messages_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `search_messages` BEGIN INSERT INTO `search_messages_fts`(`docid`, `normBody`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`normBody`); END
